prompt:
[Image Type]
Editorial illustration in minimalist magazine cover style for AI Video Generator comparison

[Content]
- Central element: Five abstract flowing shapes representing different AI video models, each with subtle distinct character
- Visual metaphor: Paths converging toward a single platform node (representing Alici)
- Minimal symbolic elements: Play button icon, film strip fragments floating in negative space
- Depth layering: Foreground shapes sharp, background elements soft and blurred

[Style]
- Composition: 55% negative space, focal point center-right (golden ratio)
- Lighting: Soft ambient glow emanating from central convergence point
- Texture: Smooth polished surfaces with gentle shadows
- Format: 16:9 widescreen, horizontal orientation
- Aesthetic: Modern, minimalist, professional tech magazine

[Brand Layer]
Brand aesthetic: alici.ai (Stripe-inspired, green-centered)

Color palette:
- GREEN-CENTERED gradient: deep emerald (#059669) → fresh mint (#10B981) → soft green (#A7F3D0)
- Soft, sophisticated transitions (similar gradient feel to Stripe, but in green tones)
- Muted saturation, avoid overly vibrant colors

Style elements:
- Generous negative space (40%+ of canvas)
- Soft 3D elements with subtle shadows and highlights
- Single clear focal point (convergence point)
- Clean, breathable composition with implied motion
- Professional, trustworthy visual language

Avoid:
- Blue/purple tones (Stripe's brand colors)
- Saturated, loud colors
- Cluttered layouts with multiple equal-weight elements
- Literal screenshots or UI mockups
